context: Asuka lectures on definitions and exceptions.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: lecture; formal connectives (または/いわゆる/基準/要素/さえ/ただし) in natural home.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 定義には、明確な基準が要ります。
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 基準さえあれば、迷いませんね。
lines.en: With criteria, we won't get lost.
lines.style: attentive adult student voice, soft warm earnest engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 形または機能で、要素を分けます。
lines.en: We divide elements by form or function.
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: いわゆる例外も、あるんですよね?
lines.en: There are so-called exceptions too, right?
lines.style: thoughtful adult student voice, soft warm curious throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ただし、例外さえ基準で説明できます。
lines.en: However, even exceptions can be explained by criteria.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 重要な要素は、何でしょうか?
lines.style: engaged adult student voice, soft warm curious throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: いわゆる共通点が、最も大切な要素です。
lines.en: The so-called common point is the most important element.
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 基準さえ分かれば、応用できますね。
lines.en: Once I know the criteria, I can apply it.
lines.style: satisfied adult student voice, soft warm appreciative throughout
